about: Chevrolet and GMC enhanced (mode 22) sensors, from owner forums. GM doesn't publish these; treat each as unverified. Headers: 7E0 = engine (ECM), 7E1/7E2 = transmission (TCM) depending on the vehicle.

sensors.name: Transmission fluid temp (TCM 7E2)
sensors.note: Widely shared among Chevy/GMC truck owners (Torque Pro lists) for 2007+ trucks with a separate transmission module. Did NOT work on a 2009 Holden VE (justcommodores.com), so it varies by vehicle.

sensors.name: Transmission fluid temp (ECM 7E0)
sensors.note: Same request sent to the engine module, for older GM trucks (about 1999-2006) whose engine computer runs the transmission. Unconfirmed.
